paths.validation_split_note: No separate 427-image validation JSONL/CSV exists in this repo layout yet. data/processed/val.jsonl (427 rows) is the ORIGINAL LoRA validation set from src/build_dataset.py -- reuse it for M3 policy/threshold selection per the freeze protocol, but it is NOT the same file as the 582-image blind benchmark GT and must never be merged with it.

model.resolved_revision: UNRESOLVED -- must be recorded at first download time, see manifests/freeze_manifest.json

ocr.note: Value must always be read from pipeline.OCR_CONF_MIN at run time, not hardcoded here. This field documents the value observed in src/pipeline.py at audit time (2026-09-17) for human reference only.

image_preprocessing.note: 128x128 / 512x512. Must always be read from pipeline.MIN_PIXELS/MAX_PIXELS at run time.

generation.temperature: N/A (do_sample=False, greedy decoding per pipeline.py VLM.batch/VLM.__call__)
generation.note: Retry call uses RETRY_TMPL prompt override, not the primary USER_TMPL. See pipeline.py:544-545,86-90.

batching.note: 8 is pipeline.py's own CLI default (--batch). scripts/3_sinh_bai_nop.sh and 4_do_lai.sh historically used 16 on the original (H100) dev machine -- that choice is NOT assumed valid for this machine's 16GB card and must be re-selected, not copied.

determinism.seed_note: Generation is greedy (do_sample=False) so no sampling seed is consumed by the VLM. No random seed is used anywhere in src/pipeline.py's inference path. Any seed needed is only for benchmark-side bootstrap resampling (see bootstrap_ci.py), not for generation.
